note: What contracts/stocks-v3/bin/freeze.py freezes for the Base Revstake v3 package. Names only: every byte, selector, topic, size and digest is derived from the compiler artifacts and the dependency snapshot, never written here.

ConditionalVestingEscrowV2.role: The per-launch escrow implementation: holds the launch's 70% vesting allocation, vests it and the SUBJECT left over at graduation to the treasury, and retires the whole supply to the dead address when a launch fails. Each launch receives a Solady minimal-proxy clone of it.
ConditionalVestingEscrowV2.deployed_by: not created by this package: version 2's deployed implementation on Base (contracts/revstake-v2/deployments/base-mainnet/deployed-manifest.json), unchanged here; RegentsAutolaunchFactoryV3 takes it as a constructor argument and admits it by runtime code hash; cloned per launch by the factory

SubjectSplitterV1.role: The per-launch revenue splitter implementation every graduated launch's fees and payments land in; each graduated launch receives a Solady minimal-proxy clone of it.
SubjectSplitterV1.deployed_by: not created by this package: version 2's deployed implementation on Base (contracts/revstake-v2/deployments/base-mainnet/deployed-manifest.json), unchanged here; RegentsAutolaunchFactoryV3 takes it as a constructor argument and admits it by runtime code hash; cloned per graduation by the strategy

PaymentReceiverV1.role: The per-launch payment receiver implementation that forwards payments into the launch's splitter; cloned per receiver by the factory.
PaymentReceiverV1.deployed_by: not created by this package: version 2's deployed implementation on Base (contracts/revstake-v2/deployments/base-mainnet/deployed-manifest.json), unchanged here; RegentsAutolaunchFactoryV3 takes it as a constructor argument and admits it by runtime code hash; cloned by the factory

RegentsAutolaunchFactoryV3.role: The Revstake version 3 launch factory: creates the token, its escrow and its CCA auction for every launch on the version 3 schedule, born paused until the Governance/Regent Safe opens it.
RegentsAutolaunchFactoryV3.deployed_by: deployment script (CREATE from the deployer), the one creation of the deployment

RegentLBPStrategyV3.role: The shared migration strategy: graduates a launch that met its required raise into the official v4 pool at the auction's final clearing price, and retires a failed launch.

RevstakeLPLocker.role: Holds every graduated launch's full-range v4 position forever and routes its collected fees to the launch's splitter.

RegentFeeHook.role: The v4 fee hook every official Revstake version 3 pool is initialized with.
RegentFeeHook.deployed_by: RegentsAutolaunchFactoryV3 constructor (CREATE2 with the mined hook salt)

ContinuousClearingAuctionFactory.role: The pinned CCA factory build; the strategy binds the live Base deployment at BaseBindings.CCA_FACTORY.

ContinuousClearingAuction.role: The pinned per-launch auction build the live factory creates for every launch.
ContinuousClearingAuction.deployed_by: the live CCA factory, one per launch

UERC20Factory.role: The pinned token factory build; the factory takes version 2's deployed instance as a constructor argument and admits it by runtime code hash.
